query: Can you tell me how to report casteism?
reference_answer:
Reporting Casteist Discrimination:
Report casteist discrimination to the nearest police station or the District Social Welfare Officer. You can also contact the Tamil Nadu State Commission for SC/ST (Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes) for assistance.
answer: Reporting casteism can involve reporting incidents to local police, filing complaints with district administrations, or using social media platforms to raise awareness and document cases. [Document 1]
